title: Sotsugyou III: Wedding Bell
overview:
My wife is a high school girl, and I am her homeroom teacher. And then... the beginning of a secret life.

The newest and strongest entry in the series finally arrives.

You are a newly hired teacher at Seika Girls' High School, secretly married to one of your students. To keep your job, you must guide a special class of five problem students - your wife among them - through to graduation, and keep the marriage hidden from everyone.

At the start, choose which of the five girls is your wife. Each week, plan lessons and give advice suited to every student's strengths and weaknesses to raise her stats before the school year ends. On days off, take your wife out on dates, but if a student spots you the date is ruined and rumors start to spread. Let the gossip grow too far and the secret is out. Neglect your wife, and the marriage itself may not last.

- School festival, seaside school and sports day events played as minigames
- A gallery of event pictures to collect

妻は女子高生、僕は担任教師
そして……秘密の生活のはじまり

シリーズ最新最強作
ついに登場
